Enum ShapeClipperJoinType

Namespace
ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Specifies how convex angled joins are handled when offsetting (inflating/shrinking) paths. This enumeration is only required for offset operations (e.g. ClipperOffset) and is not used for polygon clipping operations.

Fields

Bevel = 2

Bevel joins cut the corner with a straight edge between the offset edges. Beveling is typically simpler and faster than squared joins and is common in many graphics formats.

Miter = 0

Edges are offset a specified distance and extended to their intersection points. A miter limit is enforced to prevent very long spikes at acute angles; when the limit is exceeded the join is converted to a squared/bevel form.

Round = 3

Convex joins are rounded using an arc with radius equal to the offset distance and the original join vertex as the arc center.

Square = 1

Convex joins are truncated with a squared edge. The midpoint of the squared edge is exactly the offset distance from the original vertex.
